result.requested_outcome: All-cause death by nine months after randomization

reported.analysis_population: Primary intention-to-treat population: all 817 randomized adults, analyzed by assigned treatment (408 intensified; 409 standard). Incomplete follow-up occurred in 25 intensified and 28 standard participants; inclusion in ITT does not establish complete outcome observation.

comparison_groups.assignment: Standard nine-month antituberculosis regimen plus additional rifampin 5 mg/kg/day (total 15 mg/kg/day) and levofloxacin 20 mg/kg/day for the first eight weeks
Standard nine-month antituberculosis regimen including rifampin 10 mg/kg/day plus matched placebos for the first eight weeks

target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups

measurement.metric: All-cause death by nine months after randomization

target.outcome_definition: All-cause death by nine months after randomization

result.relation_rationale: Select the reported primary ITT Cox hazard ratio for intensified versus standard treatment, stratified by HIV status and MRC grade, for the effect of assignment. Death is unrestricted by cause, matching all-cause death. The reported endpoint is labeled death by nine months after randomization, but Figure 2 explicitly includes deaths on days 274 and 275; SAP uses actual nine-month visit timing capped at day 289. Thus the reported analysis window is broader than a strict nine-month target, whose wording is retained. SAP operationally defines the randomization date using first study dose (or enrolment if untreated); equivalence to actual allocation date is unresolved. Per-protocol HR 0.91 and composite neurologic-event-or-death HR 0.99 are not the requested primary ITT mortality Result.
